entries.plain_explanation: Leases of immovable property from year to year or for any term exceeding one year require compulsory registration with sub-registrar. Unregistered leases exceeding 11 months cannot be admitted in court as evidence of the tenancy under Section 49.
For residential premises, the security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall not exceed two months' rent. (Applicable in states adopting the MTA framework).
Landlord or property manager must serve at least 24 hours' prior written notice to the tenant specifying the time and purpose before entry, which must take place only between 7:00 AM and 8:00 PM.

In absence of contract to the contrary, a residential lease is terminable with 15 days written notice. Standard equitable practice stipulates 30 days bilateral notice for residential leave-and-license agreements.
The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant on the date of taking over vacant possession of the premises from the tenant, after adjusting any lawful tenant dues.
Landlord is responsible for structural repairs, whitewashing, and main electrical/plumbing conduits. Tenant is responsible for day-to-day minor repairs, tap washers, and internal cleaning.
No tenant shall sublet whole or part of the premises or transfer or assign rights without entering into a supplementary agreement with the landlord.
The lessor covenants that if the lessee pays the rent reserved and performs the contract, the lessee may hold and enjoy the property during the term without lawful interruption.
Liquidated damages or forfeiture clauses cannot impose unreasonable penalties. Compensation is restricted only to actual proven loss rather than arbitrary total forfeiture.
Default in timely payment of rent entitles the landlord to simple interest at prescribed rates, but does not allow unlawful disconnection of essential services or utilities.
